tom_tat: VN-Index hồi 0,45% lên 1.705,91, chấm dứt chuỗi 7 phiên giảm, nhưng giá trị khớp chỉ bằng 0,67 lần bình quân 20 phiên.
Ngoại bán ròng phiên thứ 18 liên tiếp; chỉ số còn dưới MA20, MA50, MA200.
Tuần giảm thứ tư liên tiếp, tổng mất 6,0% từ 18/9.

Chỉ số hồi mà tiền trên giá bình quân gần như đứng yên (46,6% so với 45,8% hôm qua): MMs, BBs chưa có lợi thế rõ, chưa thể nói họ sẵn sàng kéo giá. Dầu khí 1/4 là MMs, BBs lỗ mà vẫn giữ hàng, dấu xấu.

Trong 40 mã thanh khoản cao nhất, mua ròng: FPT 48,0, CTG 41,0, MBB 32,5, SSI 30,6, TCB 26,8. Bán ròng: HDB 182,9, VIC 68,8, VIX 47,0, MSB 45,1.

dong_tien_theo_nhom_nganh: Ngân hàng hút 35% giá trị nhưng chỉ 10/22 mã đóng trên giá bình quân: tiền vào nhiều, giá khó giữ. Y tế và Hàng tiêu dùng cá nhân tăng mạnh nhất lại chỉ chiếm 1% giá trị mỗi nhóm; Dầu khí 4%.

Brent 105,21 USD, WTI 97,20 (Reuters, 16/10); trong tuần Brent +0,44%, WTI +5,81%. IEA 15/10: đã xả khoảng 330 triệu thùng, 100 triệu thùng còn lại xả nhanh, gồm hơn 20 triệu thùng diesel.

Theo dõi khả năng tạo đáy

Suy luận · tin cậy trung bình: 8 đợt (20 phiên) từ 10/2022; đủ để tham khảo, chưa đủ để chắc
Kết luận

Chưa phải đáy, mới là vùng cần theo dõi. VN-Index đã về 20% biên độ 60 phiên và có 1 dấu hiệu sớm (tâm lý trượt về sợ hãi), nhưng chưa có pha bán tháo: 49,9% mã đóng cửa trên giá bình quân, mức bán tháo là dưới 25%. Riêng tâm lý sợ hãi chưa đủ: thiếu dấu hiệu độ rộng thì nó không báo đáy tốt hơn bình thường.

Nên làm: Chưa bắt đáy mạnh; nếu giải ngân thì chia nhỏ, chừa tiền cho một nhịp thủng đáy.

Lịch sử: 8 đợt (20 phiên) tương tự từ 10/2022: 20 phiên sau VN-Index bình quân +4,6%, 95% số lần cao hơn; nhưng 55% số lần còn một đáy thấp hơn trong 10 phiên (sâu thêm bình quân 1,1%); lần xấu nhất −1,3%.

tom_tat: VN-Index rebounded 0.45% to 1,705.91, ending a 7-session losing streak, but matched value was only 0.67 times the 20-session average.
Foreign investors net sold for an 18th straight session; the index is still below MA20, MA50 and MA200.
A fourth straight weekly decline, down 6.0% in total since 18/9.
chi_so_va_thanh_khoan: VN-Index +7.56 points, trading between 1,696.71 and 1,713.57 without breaking the 20-session low of 1,694.77; for the week -29.18 points (-1.68%). HNX-Index 259.13 (-0.06%), UPCoM-Index 125.97 (+1.47%).
HOSE value VND 10,996bn, down 26.9% from yesterday and the lowest in the last 22 sessions; HNX was also only 0.67 times the 20-session average.
do_rong_va_gia_binh_quan_hose: 173 stocks rose, 120 fell; 181 stocks (50.0%) closed above the average price, 150 below; by matched value only 46.6% of money sat in stocks above. Highest was Travel and leisure 6/8 (75%), lowest Oil and gas 1/4 (25%).

The index rebounded while money above the average price barely moved (46.6% versus 45.8% yesterday): MMs and BBs have no clear edge yet, and it is too early to say they are ready to push prices up. Oil and gas at 1/4 means MMs and BBs are at a loss yet still holding, a bad sign.
nganh_dan_dat_va_keo_lui: Leaders: Health care +6.67% (DCL +6.8%), Personal and household goods +2.53% (PNJ +3.3%), Travel and leisure +1.29%, Banks +1.09%. VHM +3.57% to 61,000, erasing all of yesterday's loss.
Laggards: Oil and gas -0.35% (PLX -1.4%), Construction and materials -0.14%, Chemicals -0.07%; VIC -1.4%. No sector fell more than 0.4%: sellers have not dumped yet.
khoi_ngoai: HOSE net sold VND 535.1bn, an 18th straight session since 23/9, cumulatively about VND 24,200bn (VND 14,465bn excluding the 9/10 negotiated session); HNX -VND 17.2bn.
Among the 40 most liquid stocks, net bought: FPT 48.0, CTG 41.0, MBB 32.5, SSI 30.6, TCB 26.8. Net sold: HDB 182.9, VIC 68.8, VIX 47.0, MSB 45.1.

CTG and TCB were net sold VND 62.6bn and VND 95.9bn yesterday and are now being bought; FPT net bought for a second session (VND 63.2bn). HDB was sold VND 182.9bn yet its price held at 22,800: someone is absorbing the supply.
dong_tien_theo_nhom_nganh: Banks drew 35% of value but only 10/22 stocks closed above the average price: a lot of money in, prices hard to hold. Health care and Personal goods, the strongest gainers, each took only 1% of value; Oil and gas 4%.

y: on 15/10 the Dow +1.08% (52,177.69), S&P 500 +0.33% (7,744.06), Nasdaq +0.08%; the 10-year yield fell 10 basis points to 5.089%. The same day Nikkei -4.9% and Kospi fell 7 to 8% on worries over AI funding; this morning Nikkei +1.85% and Kospi rebounded more than 2%.

Brent USD 105.21, WTI 97.20 (Reuters, 16/10); for the week Brent +0.44%, WTI +5.81%. IEA 15/10: about 330 million barrels have been released, and the remaining 100 million barrels will be released quickly, including more than 20 million barrels of diesel.
at least 10 ships attacked since 11/10, 23 incidents since the start of the month; Iran reported a tanker on fire in the Gulf of Oman. The Houthis struck the Yemeni government palace in Aden.

nhan_dinh.quan_diem: Neutral, leaning cautious for the 19/10 session: this is a rebound lacking money rather than a reversal, as money above the average price is below 50%, foreign investors are still selling, and the index is below MA20 1,754.1 (2.7% away), MA50 1,776.3, MA200 1,797.3; RSI14 32.9.
nhan_dinh.co_so: range of 1,694.8 to 1,723; near resistance at 1,713.6 and 1,722.7 (14/10 high)
nhan_dinh.tich_cuc: only a close above 1,722.7 with matched value above VND 13,000bn would bring a test of MA20 1,754.1

Bottom, recovery or top · session 16/10

Watching for a bottom

Inference · medium confidence: 8 episodes (20 sessions) since 10/2022; enough for reference, not for certainty
Conclusion

Not a bottom yet, only a zone to watch. VN-Index is at 20% of its 60-session range with 1 early sign(s) (sentiment sliding into fear), but no washout: 49.9% of stocks closed above average price; a washout is under 25%. Fear alone is not enough: without a breadth sign it has not predicted bottoms better than normal.

What to do: Do not buy the bottom aggressively; scale in small and keep cash for one more leg down.

History: 8 episodes (20 sessions) like this since 10/2022: 20 sessions later VN-Index averaged +4.6%, higher 95% of the time; but 55% of the time a lower low came within 10 sessions (1.1% deeper on average); worst case −1.3%.

What would change it: Moves to “Early signs” with one more bottom sign while VN-Index is below 1,724; to “Bottom confirmed” when VN-Index is below 1,715 with a session under 25% of stocks above average price, or the 5-session average under 45% (now 53.6%). Watch ends if VN-Index rises above 1,733.

VN-Index 1,706 (+0.45%) sits at 20% of its 60-session range (1,669–1,853). 49.9% of stocks and 46.8% of matched value closed above average price (15/10: 57.7% and 45.7%); 5-session average 53.6%.

Đáy, hồi phục hay đỉnh · phiên 16/10

Theo dõi khả năng tạo đáy

Suy luận · tin cậy trung bình: 8 đợt (20 phiên) từ 10/2022; đủ để tham khảo, chưa đủ để chắc
Kết luận

Chưa phải đáy, mới là vùng cần theo dõi. VN-Index đã về 20% biên độ 60 phiên và có 1 dấu hiệu sớm (tâm lý trượt về sợ hãi), nhưng chưa có pha bán tháo: 49,9% mã đóng cửa trên giá bình quân, mức bán tháo là dưới 25%. Riêng tâm lý sợ hãi chưa đủ: thiếu dấu hiệu độ rộng thì nó không báo đáy tốt hơn bình thường.

Nên làm: Chưa bắt đáy mạnh; nếu giải ngân thì chia nhỏ, chừa tiền cho một nhịp thủng đáy.

Lịch sử: 8 đợt (20 phiên) tương tự từ 10/2022: 20 phiên sau VN-Index bình quân +4,6%, 95% số lần cao hơn; nhưng 55% số lần còn một đáy thấp hơn trong 10 phiên (sâu thêm bình quân 1,1%); lần xấu nhất −1,3%.

Inference · medium confidence: 8 episodes (20 sessions) since 10/2022; enough for reference, not for certainty
Conclusion

Not a bottom yet, only a zone to watch. VN-Index is at 20% of its 60-session range with 1 early sign(s) (sentiment sliding into fear), but no washout: 49.9% of stocks closed above average price; a washout is under 25%. tom_tat: VN-Index fell for a 7th straight session to 1,698.35 (-0.38%), the lowest since 28/7, despite US CPI running hotter than forecast.
By stock count buyers have a slight edge (57.9% of stocks above average price); by money it is a draw (45.8% by value).
Foreign investors net sold for a 17th straight session, but are switching stocks within banks.
chi_so_va_thanh_khoan: VN-Index ranged from 1,690.56 to 1,709.54 and has lost 60.73 points (-3.45%) since 6/10; RSI14 at 29.4. HNX-Index at 259.29 (-2.21%), the steepest fall of the four indices.

HOSE value VND 15,043bn, 0.90 times the 20-session average (HNX 1.17 times). Volume rose 17% from yesterday but value only 9.5%: the average matched price per share fell 6.6%, money crowded into low-priced stocks.
do_rong_va_gia_binh_quan_hose: 164 advancers, 151 decliners; 212 stocks (57.9%) closed above average price, 127 below; by matched value only 45.8% of money sat in stocks above. Highest: Information technology 5/7 (71%); lowest: Oil and gas 0/4.

By stock count, MMs and BBs were in profit for the session; by value the two sides are balanced, too early to say they are ready to push prices up. Oil and gas at 0/4 means MMs and BBs are at a loss, and holding stock there is a bad sign.
nganh_dan_dat_va_keo_lui: Leaders: Construction and building materials +4.61% (CII +6.1%, VCG +5.6%), Financial services +2.19%, Information technology +1.53% (FPT +1.58% even though the US semiconductor index fell about 4%).
Laggards: Insurance -5.90% (BVH -6.05%), Oil and gas -5.09% (BSR -6.31%), Personal goods -2.07%; VHM -3.44% to 58,900.
khoi_ngoai: Net sold VND 685.6bn on HOSE (HNX -25.1), the 17th straight session since 23/9, cumulative about VND 23,665bn (VND 13,930bn excluding the 9/10 negotiated-deal session).
Net bought: MBB 102.2 (VND 202.8bn over two sessions), VPB 52.8, PVT 50.6. Net sold: VIC 134.4, STB 131.1 (net bought 43.9 yesterday), TCB 95.9, CTG 62.6.

MBB, VPB, SHB net bought about VND 197bn, STB, TCB, CTG net sold about VND 290bn: foreign investors are switching stocks, not abandoning banks. FPT was net bought VND 15.2bn, ending a 6-session selling streak.
dong_tien_theo_nhom_nganh: Financial services drew 13% of matched value, price +2.19%: buyers in control. Oil and gas drew 6% while price fell 5.09%: sellers in control. Construction 4%, Information technology 2%: the gains are thinly funded.

y: September CPI +0.6%, 3.7% year on year (forecast 3.6%); core +0.3% (forecast 0.2%). 10-year yield 5.304%, up 9 basis points; Nasdaq -1.88%.

Brent around USD 104 this morning, down 1.6% from 106.06 yesterday after news that the US is considering easing sanctions on the tanker fleet (Reuters), even as the Houthis attacked Aramco headquarters and two cargo ships sank in Hormuz. The IEA meets on 15/10 on releasing 100 million barrels.

nhan_dinh.quan_diem: Negative in the short term but selling is slowing: core CPI at 0.3%, exactly yesterday's Negative condition, cost the index only 0.38%; too early to call a bottom while foreign investors are still net selling and the index is below MA20, MA50, MA200 (1,759.6; 1,777.7; 1,797.6).
nhan_dinh.tich_cuc: a close above 1,716 with matched value back to average means a rebound to 1,740 to 1,760
nhan_dinh.tieu_cuc:
a close below 1,690.6 means a test of 1,651.2 (28/7 low), 2.8% away.
Sectors and stocks: Information technology and Financial services still attract money; watch MBB, VPB following foreign flows; no new positions in VHM, VIC until foreign investors stop selling; BSR, PVT wait for Brent to stabilise
nhan_dinh.moc: IEA 15/10, FOMC 27 to 28/10, US October CPI on 10/11
